description: Transactions with amount, merchant, status, and timestamps. Pass card_id for one card's transactions; OMIT it for every card in the account (newest first, each row tagged with its card). Use limit and status to filter. The gated views list_all_transactions and list_transactions_by_payment_method also exist; call them by name even though they aren't in the tools list.

card_id.description: A card ID for that card's transactions; omit for all cards in the account.

limit.description: Max number of transactions to return (default 20)

offset.description: Skip this many (all-cards view pagination; ignored for a single card).

status.description: Filter by transaction status (e.g. PENDING, SETTLED, DECLINED, REVERSED, EXPIRED, REFUNDED)

name: list_transactions

message.description: Human-readable list of transactions (or a "no transactions" note).

transactions.description: The transactions for the card, newest first.

cardId.description: Card ID (present in the all-cards view; null for wallet-funding rows).

cardLast4.description: Last four of the card (present in the all-cards view; null for wallet-funding rows).

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the transaction was created.

processorTransactionId.description: The card processor's reference for the charge, the value transaction.* webhook events carry as data.id (their transaction_id is this row's id). Null for wallet-funding rows.

status.description: Status, e.g. PENDING, SETTLED, DECLINED, REVERSED, EXPIRED, REFUNDED.
